newsitem.title: FRANCE: Israeli armed forces chief visits France.
newsitem.headline: Israeli armed forces chief visits France.

text.p: Israel's armed forces chief of staff, Lieutenant-General Amnon Shahak, arrived in France on Monday for a five-day working visit.

The French Defence Ministry said Shahak, a guest of French armed forces chief General Jean-Philippe Douin, would visit French army, navy and airforce bases in Paris and the provinces and discuss military policy issues.
The Israeli army said Shahak was accompanied by operations chief Major-General Gabi Ashkenazi.

After Israel and the Palestine Liberation Organisation signed peace accords in 1993, France, once Israel's main arms supplier, resumed military cooperation with the Jewish state which General Charles de Gaulle had broken off during the 1967 Middle East war.

But French Defence Minister Charles Millon postponed a planned visit to Israel in July, following the election of a hardline government in Israel opposed to trading Arab land for peace, and said the prospects of closer arms cooperation between the two countries hinged on progress in the peace process.
